description: A prominent, slightly sinuous NNW–SSE trending raised causeway or ridge visible in the DTM. This linear feature is consistently 2–3 m wide, stands ~0.3–0.5 m above surrounding forest floor, and extends for approximately 1.8 km. It cuts across natural micro‐drainage, indicating intentional routing.

A rectilinear grid of orthogonal embankments and shallow ditches forming at least three contiguous field blocks. Each block measures roughly 100–150 m per side. The embankments show paired convex‐concave curvature in cross‐section, consistent with paired raised‐field construction for water‐management.
